//This ensures that s2n-tls is compiled and deployed with a specific
//\nversion of libcrypto by interning the code and hiding symbols.
// This also enables s2n-tls to be
//\nloaded in an application with an otherwise conflicting libcrypto
// version.
S2N_INTERN_LIBCRYPTO:BOOL=OFF

//Enables link time optimizations when building s2n-tls.
S2N_LTO,:BOOL=OFF

//Disables all Post Quantum Crypto code. You likely want this
//\nfor older compilers or uncommon platforms.
S2N_NO_PQ:BOOL=OFF

//Turns off the ASM for PQ Crypto even if it's available for the
// toolchain.
//\nYou likely want this on older compilers.
S2N_NO_PQ_ASM:BOOL=OFF

//Set this if you want to let S2N search libcrypto for you,
//\notherwise a crypto target needs to be defined.
